real: Fed cuts its main interest rate to 4.25%
anon: Central bank cuts the rate it sets for banks again
note: Third cut of the cycle; FOMC statement 11 Dec 2007.

real: Fed opens new bank lending and swaps dollars with ECB
anon: Central banks act to help banks short of cash
note: Term Auction Facility and swap lines announced 12 Dec.

real: Fed cuts rates by 0.75 points between meetings
anon: The central bank cuts borrowing costs in a surprise move
note: US markets were closed 21 Jan (MLK Day); cut announced the morning of 22 Jan, an intermeeting cut of 75bp to 3.5%.

real: Bush signs the tax rebate stimulus law
anon: The president signs a law to boost spending
note: Economic Stimulus Act of 2008 signed 13 Feb.

real: Fed backs emergency loan to Bear Stearns
anon: A big finance firm runs short of cash and gets help
note: Fed approved the JPMorgan/NY Fed financing arrangement Friday 14 Mar.

real: Over the weekend, JPMorgan agrees to buy Bear Stearns
anon: Over the weekend, a struggling firm is sold off cheaply
note: Deal agreed Sunday 16 Mar, same day the Fed created the Primary Dealer Credit Facility; so shown on Monday.

real: Fed cuts its main interest rate to 2.25%
anon: Central bank cuts rates sharply again
note: 75bp cut to 2.25% on 18 Mar.

real: After Friday's close, regulators close IndyMac
anon: After the close, a big home lender is shut
note: IndyMac closed Friday 11 Jul by OTS; FDIC took over. Adjudication: OTS release 6pm Fri 11 Jul, so moved to Mon 14 Jul.

real: Bush signs law to shore up Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac
anon: The president signs a law to support home lending
note: Housing and Economic Recovery Act signed 30 Jul.

real: Over the weekend, US seizes Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac
anon: Over the weekend, the state takes over two big lenders
note: Conservatorship announced Sunday 7 Sep.

real: Wall Street bank Lehman Brothers files for bankruptcy
anon: A major bank files for bankruptcy
note: Chapter 11 filed early Monday 15 Sep. Same day Bank of America agreed to buy Merrill Lynch.

real: After the close, Fed lends AIG up to $85 billion
anon: After the close, the state steps in to save a big firm
note: Announced the evening of Tue 16 Sep, after the close, so shown on 17 Sep.

real: US backs money market accounts and bans short selling
anon: Officials move on two fronts to calm frightened markets
note: Treasury temporary guaranty announced 19 Sep after Reserve Primary broke the buck on 16 Sep. Merged in the SEC short-sale ban (order dated and effective 19 Sep): https://www.sec.gov/news/press/2008/2008-211.htm

real: Overnight, regulators seize Washington Mutual
anon: In the night, regulators seize a huge lender
note: Seized by OTS Thursday evening 25 Sep, after the close; sold to JPMorgan. Largest US bank failure by assets.

real: House rejects the $700 billion bank rescue plan
anon: Lawmakers reject a rescue plan; shares plunge
note: House vote Monday 29 Sep, 228 to 205. Also the day of the Citigroup/Wachovia deal.

real: Bush signs the bank rescue law, raising deposit cover
anon: A rescue for the banks becomes law
note: EESA signed 3 Oct after House passed it on second vote. Merged in the FDIC $250,000 cover, in force from 3 Oct under EESA: https://www.fdic.gov/resources/regulations/federal-register-publications/2008/08interimOct17.html

real: Fed and other central banks cut interest rates together
anon: Several central banks cut borrowing costs at once
note: Coordinated cut, Fed 50bp to 1.5%, 8 Oct.

real: Over the weekend, rich nations pledge to back banks
anon: Over the weekend, governments promise to support banks
note: G7 and euro-area plans over weekend 10-12 Oct; Fed expanded swap lines Mon 13 Oct. Close +11.6% in the file.

real: US Treasury to put $250 billion into banks
anon: The state will put money straight into banks
note: Capital Purchase Program announced 14 Oct; FDIC debt guarantee same day.

real: Fed survey says the economy weakened across the country
anon: Survey shows the whole economy sliding, region by region
note: Beige Book published 15 Oct 2008. Close -9.0% in the file.

real: Treasury buys $125 billion of shares in nine big banks
anon: The first public money reaches the big banks
note: Announced 14 Oct; money paid 28 Oct. Close +10.8% in the file.

real: Fed cuts its main interest rate to 1%
anon: The central bank cuts borrowing costs again
note: 50bp cut to 1% on 29 Oct.

real: US lends AIG more and buys $40 billion of its shares
anon: A big rescue deal is made bigger
note: Restructured AIG support, 10 Nov.

real: Over the weekend, US backs Citigroup against losses
anon: Over the weekend, the state steps in at a big bank
note: Citigroup guarantee and capital package announced Sunday 23 Nov. Close +6.5% in the file.

real: Fed starts a $200 billion consumer loan scheme
anon: The central bank acts to keep household loans flowing
note: TALF announced 25 Nov, alongside GSE debt/MBS buying (up to $600bn).

real: Economists officially declare the US in recession
anon: Experts declare that a slump is under way
note: NBER dated the peak to Dec 2007 on 1 Dec 2008 (St. Louis Fed timeline shows 11 Dec). Close -8.9% in the file.

real: Fed takes its main interest rate down to almost zero
anon: The central bank makes a big cut in borrowing costs
note: Target range 0 to 0.25%. Close +5.1% in the file.

real: US lends General Motors and Chrysler $17.4 billion
anon: The state lends money to struggling firms
note: Treasury authorised TARP loans 19 Dec; figure about $17.4bn (13.4 GM + 4 Chrysler). Checker: confirm total.

real: US announces a rescue package for Bank of America
anon: A second giant lender gets help from the state
note: Loss-sharing package announced 16 Jan.

real: Geithner unveils a plan to fix the banks
anon: A new plan to fix the banks is unveiled
note: Financial Stability Plan announced 10 Feb. Close -4.9% in the file.

real: Obama signs a $787 billion spending and tax-cut law
anon: The president signs a big plan to boost the economy
note: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act signed 17 Feb; cost of $787bn is the figure at signing.

real: Regulators announce stress tests for the biggest banks
anon: Officials say big banks will be checked for strength
note: Announced 25 Feb.

real: US deepens its rescue of AIG after record loss
anon: A rescued company needs yet more help
note: Announced 2 Mar, after AIG reported its Q4 loss of about $62bn on 2 Mar. Checker: confirm.

real: Fed to buy Treasuries and more mortgage debt
anon: The central bank will create money to support markets
note: FOMC 18 Mar.

real: Treasury details a plan to buy banks' bad assets
anon: The state unveils a plan to clean up the banks
note: Public-Private Investment Program details 23 Mar. Close +7.1% in the file; fall ends here.

real: Accounting board eases rules on valuing banks' assets
anon: Rule-makers give banks more room in their accounts
note: FASB issued guidance 2 Apr (final FSPs 9 Apr).

real: After the close, Fed publishes bank stress test results
anon: After the close, results of bank health checks are out
note: Results released 7 May. Adjudication: results released 5pm 7 May, so moved to 8 May.
